description.value: Fairway Market is a Vancouver Island-owned independent grocery chain operating since 1963, with the Nanaimo location situated in North Town Centre. The store offers a full supermarket range including deli, produce, bakery, dairy, and meat departments alongside specialty counters such as Asian Kitchen and Sushi Village. As one of Vancouver Island's largest independently owned grocery chains with 9 locations, it is a well-established resupply point for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a supermarket (shop=supermarket) in Nanaimo, and the website confirms an active Fairway Market chain with a Nanaimo North Town Centre location, corroborating the business identity. The website lists departments including Deli, Asian Kitchen, and Sushi Village, confirming prepared/hot food offerings alongside full grocery departments. Neither the OSM tags nor the website content mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
